composedReading.en: At “What deserves attention”, The Fool brings unrestrained impulse and uncertain direction into focus. Use The Fool to examine unrestrained impulse and uncertain direction; compare the symbolic perspective with real-world evidence before drawing any conclusion. In this position, the reading is asking: What in the card helps you notice something you may otherwise overlook?
composedReading.zhHans: 在「最值得注意什么」这个位置，The Fool 把「不受约束的冲动与未定方向」带到焦点。使用「The Fool」检视“不受约束的冲动与未定方向”；在得出任何结论前，把象征视角与现实证据进行比较。 放在这个牌位里，更值得继续追问的是：这张牌让你注意到什么原本可能忽略的部分？

headline.en: One clear symbolic focus for what deserves attention now.
headline.zhHans: 用一个象征焦点，看此刻最值得注意什么。

narrative.en: This 1-card reading opens with The Fool at “What deserves attention” and closes with The Fool at “What deserves attention”. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 1 independent verdicts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 1 张牌的读取从 The Fool（「最值得注意什么」）开始，以 The Fool（「最值得注意什么」）收束。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 1 个彼此独立的判决。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

statement.en: Compare the opening position “What shaped this situation” with the closing position “What deserves consideration next”. The useful question is what changes between those two lenses, not whether the last card guarantees an outcome.

headline.en: Background, current situation, and what deserves consideration next.
headline.zhHans: 形成背景、当前局面、接下来值得考虑什么。

narrative.en: This 3-card reading opens with The Chariot at “What shaped this situation” and closes with The Star at “What deserves consideration next”. Between them, The Hanged Man at “What is most present now” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 3 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 3 张牌的读取从 The Chariot（「形成背景」）开始，以 The Star（「接下来值得考虑」）收束。 中间的The Hanged Man（当前局面）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 3 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

statement.en: 2 of 5 cards are Major Arcana. Treat that as structural emphasis across several positions, not as proof that events are predetermined.

statement.en: WANDS appears 3 times. Compare how the repeated suit shows up in different positions instead of reducing it to one universal meaning.
statement.zhHans: WANDS 在这次牌阵中出现 3 次。重点不是套用一个统一牌义，而是比较同一组牌在不同牌位里怎样重复出现。

statement.en: Compare the opening position “Your current position” with the closing position “What Path B may develop”. The useful question is what changes between those two lenses, not whether the last card guarantees an outcome.

headline.en: Compare two paths without turning Tarot into a decision maker.
headline.zhHans: 比较两条路径，而不是让塔罗替你决定。

narrative.en: This 5-card reading opens with Temperance at “Your current position” and closes with Queen of Wands at “What Path B may develop”. Between them, The Sun at “What Path A may answer in you”, Three of Wands at “What Path B may answer in you”, Eight of Wands at “What Path A may develop” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 5 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 5 张牌的读取从 Temperance（「你当前的位置」）开始，以 Queen of Wands（「B 路径可能形成什么」）收束。 中间的The Sun（A 路径回应的需要）、Three of Wands（B 路径回应的需要）、Eight of Wands（A 路径可能形成什么）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 5 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

composedReading.en: At “My current position”, The World brings completion, success, and movement into a wider field into focus. Use The World to examine completion, success, and movement into a wider field; compare the symbolic perspective with real-world evidence before drawing any conclusion. In this position, the reading is asking: What does this card suggest you examine about your own position or participation?

narrative.en: This 5-card reading opens with The World at “My current position” and closes with Six of Cups at “What deserves discussion or verification”. Between them, Five of Wands at “The relationship as it is operating now”, Ten of Wands at “The other person’s visible position”, Ace of Cups at “What direction is emerging” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 5 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 5 张牌的读取从 The World（「我的当前立场」）开始，以 Six of Cups（「值得讨论或验证的问题」）收束。 中间的Five of Wands（关系当前结构）、Ten of Wands（对方在关系中的可见位置）、Ace of Cups（正在形成的方向）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 5 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

narrative.en: This 5-card reading opens with Seven of Wands at “Current state” and closes with Queen of Cups at “What direction may form if the current pattern continues”. Between them, Knight of Wands at “What the timing is asking of you”, Three of Cups at “What is influencing the situation”, Eight of Cups at “What conditions support success” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 5 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 5 张牌的读取从 Seven of Wands（「当下状态」）开始，以 Queen of Cups（「当前模式持续时的发展方向」）收束。 中间的Knight of Wands（当前时机）、Three of Cups（影响因素）、Eight of Cups（支持成功的条件）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 5 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

headline.en: A PHI OS signature spread that turns symbolism back toward reality checking and next observation.

narrative.en: This 6-card reading opens with King of Wands at “Current Reality” and closes with Page of Swords at “Next observation or action”. Between them, Five of Cups at “What is most visible”, Ten of Cups at “What may be misread”, Ace of Swords at “What deserves attention”, Six of Swords at “What needs reality verification” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 6 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 6 张牌的读取从 King of Wands（「当前现实」）开始，以 Page of Swords（「下一步观察或行动」）收束。 中间的Five of Cups（最容易看见什么）、Ten of Cups（哪里可能被误读）、Ace of Swords（什么最值得注意）、Six of Swords（什么需要回到现实验证）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 6 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

narrative.en: This 7-card reading opens with Seven of Cups at “Background” and closes with Nine of Pentacles at “If the current pattern continues”. Between them, Knight of Cups at “Current state”, Three of Swords at “What is changing”, Eight of Swords at “A response worth considering”, Queen of Swords at “Environment / other visible factors”, Four of Pentacles at “Core obstacle” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 7 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 7 张牌的读取从 Seven of Cups（「背景」）开始，以 Nine of Pentacles（「如果当前模式继续」）收束。 中间的Knight of Cups（当前状态）、Three of Swords（正在形成的变化）、Eight of Swords（可以考虑的回应）、Queen of Swords（环境 / 他人可见因素）、Four of Pentacles（核心障碍）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 7 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

narrative.en: This 10-card reading opens with King of Cups at “Core situation” and closes with The Tower at “If the current pattern continues”. Between them, Five of Swords at “Primary tension”, Ten of Swords at “What you consciously understand”, Ace of Pentacles at “A deeper driver to examine”, Six of Pentacles at “What has already shaped the situation”, Page of Pentacles at “What is beginning to emerge”, The Magician at “Your position in it”, The Lovers at “Environment / others’ visible role”, Justice at “Hopes and concerns” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 10 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.

headline.en: Background, current situation, and what deserves consideration next.

narrative.en: This 3-card reading opens with King of Swords at “What shaped this situation” and closes with Ten of Pentacles at “What deserves consideration next”. Between them, Five of Pentacles at “What is most present now” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 3 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 3 张牌的读取从 King of Swords（「形成背景」）开始，以 Ten of Pentacles（「接下来值得考虑」）收束。 中间的Five of Pentacles（当前局面）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 3 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

narrative.en: This 5-card reading opens with Seven of Pentacles at “Your current position” and closes with The Hanged Man at “What Path B may develop”. Between them, Knight of Pentacles at “What Path A may answer in you”, The High Priestess at “What Path B may answer in you”, The Chariot at “What Path A may develop” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 5 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 5 张牌的读取从 Seven of Pentacles（「你当前的位置」）开始，以 The Hanged Man（「B 路径可能形成什么」）收束。 中间的Knight of Pentacles（A 路径回应的需要）、The High Priestess（B 路径回应的需要）、The Chariot（A 路径可能形成什么）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 5 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

statement.en: 4 of 5 cards are Major Arcana. Treat that as structural emphasis across several positions, not as proof that events are predetermined.

statement.en: Compare the opening position “My current position” with the closing position “What deserves discussion or verification”. The useful question is what changes between those two lenses, not whether the last card guarantees an outcome.
statement.zhHans: 把开端的「我的当前立场」与最后的「值得讨论或验证的问题」放在一起比较。真正有用的是看两种视角之间发生了什么变化，而不是把最后一张牌当作保证结果。

headline.en: Explore your position, the relationship structure, the other person’s visible position, direction, and what needs discussion.
headline.zhHans: 看自己的位置、关系结构、对方可见的位置、发展方向与值得讨论的问题。

narrative.en: This 5-card reading opens with King of Pentacles at “My current position” and closes with The Sun at “What deserves discussion or verification”. Between them, The Emperor at “The relationship as it is operating now”, The Hermit at “The other person’s visible position”, Temperance at “What direction is emerging” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 5 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 5 张牌的读取从 King of Pentacles（「我的当前立场」）开始，以 The Sun（「值得讨论或验证的问题」）收束。 中间的The Emperor（关系当前结构）、The Hermit（对方在关系中的可见位置）、Temperance（正在形成的方向）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 5 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

statement.zhHans: 5 张牌中有 4 张大阿尔卡那。可以把它视为多个牌位共同出现的结构性强调，而不是“事情已经注定”的证据。

statement.en: Compare the opening position “Current state” with the closing position “What direction may form if the current pattern continues”. The useful question is what changes between those two lenses, not whether the last card guarantees an outcome.
statement.zhHans: 把开端的「当下状态」与最后的「当前模式持续时的发展方向」放在一起比较。真正有用的是看两种视角之间发生了什么变化，而不是把最后一张牌当作保证结果。

headline.en: Current state, timing, influences, success conditions, and likely direction if the pattern continues.
headline.zhHans: 当前状态、时机、影响因素、成功条件，以及当前模式持续时的可能方向。

narrative.en: This 5-card reading opens with The Lovers at “Current state” and closes with Five of Wands at “What direction may form if the current pattern continues”. Between them, Justice at “What the timing is asking of you”, The Tower at “What is influencing the situation”, The World at “What conditions support success” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 5 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 5 张牌的读取从 The Lovers（「当下状态」）开始，以 Five of Wands（「当前模式持续时的发展方向」）收束。 中间的Justice（当前时机）、The Tower（影响因素）、The World（支持成功的条件）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 5 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

statement.en: WANDS appears 3 times. Compare how the repeated suit shows up in different positions instead of reducing it to one universal meaning.

statement.en: Compare the opening position “Current Reality” with the closing position “Next observation or action”. The useful question is what changes between those two lenses, not whether the last card guarantees an outcome.

headline.en: A PHI OS signature spread that turns symbolism back toward reality checking and next observation.
headline.zhHans: PHI OS 标志性牌阵：把象征重新带回现实验证与下一步观察。

narrative.en: This 6-card reading opens with Death at “Current Reality” and closes with Three of Cups at “Next observation or action”. Between them, The Moon at “What is most visible”, Two of Wands at “What may be misread”, Seven of Wands at “What deserves attention”, Knight of Wands at “What needs reality verification” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 6 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 6 张牌的读取从 Death（「当前现实」）开始，以 Three of Cups（「下一步观察或行动」）收束。 中间的The Moon（最容易看见什么）、Two of Wands（哪里可能被误读）、Seven of Wands（什么最值得注意）、Knight of Wands（什么需要回到现实验证）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 6 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

narrative.en: This 7-card reading opens with Judgement at “Background” and closes with Ace of Swords at “If the current pattern continues”. Between them, Four of Wands at “Current state”, Nine of Wands at “What is changing”, King of Wands at “A response worth considering”, Five of Cups at “Environment / other visible factors”, Ten of Cups at “Core obstacle” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 7 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 7 张牌的读取从 Judgement（「背景」）开始，以 Ace of Swords（「如果当前模式继续」）收束。 中间的Four of Wands（当前状态）、Nine of Wands（正在形成的变化）、King of Wands（可以考虑的回应）、Five of Cups（环境 / 他人可见因素）、Ten of Cups（核心障碍）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 7 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

narrative.en: This 10-card reading opens with Six of Wands at “Core situation” and closes with Nine of Pentacles at “If the current pattern continues”. Between them, Page of Wands at “Primary tension”, Two of Cups at “What you consciously understand”, Seven of Cups at “A deeper driver to examine”, Knight of Cups at “What has already shaped the situation”, Three of Swords at “What is beginning to emerge”, Eight of Swords at “Your position in it”, Queen of Swords at “Environment / others’ visible role”, Four of Pentacles at “Hopes and concerns” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 10 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.

statement.en: CUPS appears 2 times. Compare how the repeated suit shows up in different positions instead of reducing it to one universal meaning.

statement.en: Compare the opening position “What shaped this situation” with the closing position “What deserves consideration next”. The useful question is what changes between those two lenses, not whether the last card guarantees an outcome.
statement.zhHans: 把开端的「形成背景」与最后的「接下来值得考虑」放在一起比较。真正有用的是看两种视角之间发生了什么变化，而不是把最后一张牌当作保证结果。

headline.en: Background, current situation, and what deserves consideration next.
headline.zhHans: 形成背景、当前局面、接下来值得考虑什么。

narrative.en: This 3-card reading opens with Six of Cups at “What shaped this situation” and closes with Two of Swords at “What deserves consideration next”. Between them, Page of Cups at “What is most present now” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 3 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 3 张牌的读取从 Six of Cups（「形成背景」）开始，以 Two of Swords（「接下来值得考虑」）收束。 中间的Page of Cups（当前局面）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 3 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

narrative.en: This 5-card reading opens with Queen of Cups at “Your current position” and closes with Five of Pentacles at “What Path B may develop”. Between them, Four of Swords at “What Path A may answer in you”, Nine of Swords at “What Path B may answer in you”, King of Swords at “What Path A may develop” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 5 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 5 张牌的读取从 Queen of Cups（「你当前的位置」）开始，以 Five of Pentacles（「B 路径可能形成什么」）收束。 中间的Four of Swords（A 路径回应的需要）、Nine of Swords（B 路径回应的需要）、King of Swords（A 路径可能形成什么）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 5 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。

headline.en: Explore your position, the relationship structure, the other person’s visible position, direction, and what needs discussion.
headline.zhHans: 看自己的位置、关系结构、对方可见的位置、发展方向与值得讨论的问题。

narrative.en: This 5-card reading opens with Six of Swords at “My current position” and closes with Knight of Pentacles at “What deserves discussion or verification”. Between them, Page of Swords at “The relationship as it is operating now”, Two of Pentacles at “The other person’s visible position”, Seven of Pentacles at “What direction is emerging” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 5 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
narrative.zhHans: 这次 5 张牌的读取从 Six of Swords（「我的当前立场」）开始，以 Knight of Pentacles（「值得讨论或验证的问题」）收束。 中间的Page of Swords（关系当前结构）、Two of Pentacles（对方在关系中的可见位置）、Seven of Pentacles（正在形成的方向）则提供了需要与原问题一起理解的中间视角。重点是把整副牌当成同一个问题上的连续视角，而不是 5 个彼此独立的判决。 上述多牌结构只用于比较，不会因此产生新的现实事实。

decisionBoundary.en: The spread may organize reflection; it does not choose for you, diagnose anyone, reveal hidden facts, or guarantee a future event.
decisionBoundary.zhHans: 牌阵可以帮助组织反思，但不会替你做决定、诊断任何人、揭示隐藏事实或保证未来事件。

summary.en: No current Reality context was used. Treat the reading as a set of symbolic hypotheses and look for real observations that could support, contradict, or leave them unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 这次没有使用当前 Reality context。请把读取视为一组象征性的待验证假设，再回到现实中寻找能够支持、反驳，或让它继续保持未定的观察。
